card.name: Leading 1 in sodium and radiation values
card.fires_on: The digit 1 starting a number like 130, 145 or 1.8 in serum sodium thresholds, and the words just before radiation therapy dosing (to, an opening parenthesis).

modes.label: Sodium level numbers
modes.description: The first digit 1 of a serum sodium value after greater than, lower than or a comparison sign.

modes.label: Radiation dose and timing
modes.description: The leading 1 of a Gy dose range, or the words 'to' or '(' right before radiation therapy details.
